user.description: Spools read by ESPHome pn5180 readers (esphome.openprinttag events) get a sensor on the reader's device, with the tag data and the OpenPrintTag database record.

update.name: Update spool
update.description: Writes values to the aux region of the OpenPrintTag on the reader (only the changed blocks). The sensor updates when the reader has read the tag again.

consume.name: Consume
consume.description: Filament used now, added to the consumed weight (e.g. after a print).

gross_weight.name: Gross weight
gross_weight.description: The spool weighed with its container; the consumed weight is computed from the tag's full and empty spool weights.

storage_location.name: Storage location
storage_location.description: Where the spool is kept. Empty removes it.

workgroup.name: Workgroup
workgroup.description: Who the spool belongs to. Empty removes it.
